note: OpenAI's list prices for its own API (api.openai.com); a provider's price: in providers.yaml wins. Token-priced models (gpt-4o-mini-tts) are left out: their cost is not a function of minutes or characters.

minimax.note: MiniMax's pay-as-you-go list prices on its international site (api.minimax.io): Speech-to-Text $0.38 per hour, T2A per million billable characters (MiniMax counts a Chinese character as 2; the adapter prices extra_info.usage_characters). The China site (api.minimaxi.com) lists prices in CNY only (https://platform.minimaxi.com/docs/pricing/overview.md: ASR 2.50 CNY/hour, T2A 3.50 / 2.00 CNY per 10,000 characters), so it is left unpriced: no exchange rate is guessed. A price: in providers.yaml or gateway-prices.yaml wins.
